reuse_review.capture_owner_ledger: Not reusable: capture_signing domain and record bindings do not authorize five MinIO purposes.
reuse_review.system_backup_v2_provider_capabilities: Not reusable: observed capability/evidence cache has no independently enrolled issuer, signed original purpose mapping or current owner revocation authority.
reuse_review.kubernetes_permission_head: Retained as an independent native Prepare source; a copied head or cached GET cannot supply same-transaction SQL current authority.

ownership.D: Additive schema, complete migration catalog, canonical/mirror classification and control-table exclusion. No SQL execution or runtime authority installation.
ownership.C: Reviewed domain-separated record types, independently authenticated original operator/issuer installer, atomic CAS/revoke and partial/unknown-commit recovery; exact native permission/capability binding and short observation freshness. No signing key is mounted into bootstrap consumer.
ownership.A: Same-original-transaction authority read/lock/verification and actual resource/candidate authority consumption. Reject unavailable or mismatched current source before operation lookup; no allow-all Original.
ownership.root: Independent review/tests/native verification, integration, source freeze and test/build artifact cleanup.

system_backup_minio_owner_heads.authority_id: Independently pinned original MinIO authority selector; never inferred from a candidate, provider response, future config or task. Multiple authorities are locked in ASCII byte order of the complete key.
system_backup_minio_owner_heads.no_grant_fk: Head intentionally has no reverse FK to grant: installer first locks/creates head, then grant, then refs in one transaction. An externally visible active head with a missing grant is rejected. Never use deferred external repair as readiness.

system_backup_minio_owner_grants.foreign_key: First three columns -> exact MinIO head, ON DELETE RESTRICT.

system_backup_minio_owner_refs.foreign_key: First five columns -> exact grant revision, ON DELETE RESTRICT.
system_backup_minio_owner_refs.order: Lock five exact keys in the listed ASCII purpose order. Do not rely on a database optimizer's multi-row locking order or ENUM presentation order. Reject fewer/more/different mappings; no partial authority.

signed_payload_contract.encoding: Canonical UTF-8 JSON, exact raw byte hash, Ed25519 signature; reject noncanonical/unknown/duplicate fields. No raw passwords, access/secret keys or private signing key bytes. SQL JSON_VALID/hash checks alone are not signature or provenance verification.

signed_payload_contract.state_semantics: Head state is signed and must equal SQL head_state. Grant/ref immutable signed raw records authenticate the original mappings; their current SQL active/revoked state and row_version are additional controlled current authority. Never turn revoked rows active again. Every head mutation increments head_revision and row_version; replacement grant epoch strictly increases; revocation may retain the selected grant epoch while signing a new revoked head.
signed_payload_contract.index_parity: Verify exact signed payload/index parity for every duplicated identity, selector, revision, epoch and mapping field before using a row. A valid signature over another row is not accepted. Head selected grant raw hash and exact five grant-listed ref hashes must equal actual selected bytes. All signatures use the independently pinned MinIO SQL issuer, never the capture signing domain or a key supplied by these rows.

locking_and_cas.consumer: Use the caller's existing original controlled SQL transaction. MySQL 8.4 SELECT ... FOR SHARE, exact keys and strict bounded payloads; verify current server/account/database/time via the existing transaction contract. No new transaction, commit, network, Kube GET, credential read/hash, native probe or signing inside L2. History also checks current identity/head/revocation before return. Fresh use additionally checks the separately short physical observation deadline.
locking_and_cas.installer: Authenticate original enrollment/admin and inspect native permission/capability outside write locks. Begin one controlled transaction, acquire the same ordered prefix with FOR UPDATE, verify exact expected head revision/hash/row_version/state and all grant/ref row versions, then atomically insert the next grant plus all five refs and CAS the signed head. First install requires absence under the controlled key lock; duplicate/concurrent first install fails closed. No enabled config, operation, task, capture certificate or future backup object is a prerequisite.
locking_and_cas.revoke: Same ordered locks and exact original expected values. Sign a new revoked head, CAS head revision/row_version, revoke current grant/all five refs with row_version increments atomically. Zero affected rows, missing/extra refs or unexpected state aborts. Never lock earlier-domain rows after MinIO locks. No DELETE permission or automatic history cleanup.
locking_and_cas.unknown_commit: C must define concrete idempotent independent readback by original tuple and all expected hashes/versions; an uncertain commit is unavailable until resolved. Never overwrite drift, regenerate identity/window or treat a previous receipt as current authority.
locking_and_cas.dual_source: C must bind installed SQL signed head to actual original Kube/native grant/head identities and explicit epoch. Prepare rejects either-source mismatch/revocation; L2 consumes current controlled SQL source. Coordinated owner mutation/recovery must fail closed during partial Kube/SQL transition. This migration does not claim distributed atomicity.

observation_limits.permissions: Exact native users/policies and declared protocol support are separate. Named/effective PutObject permission does not prove immutable conditional create, checksum rejection, exact-version EOF, cleanup or canonical catalog append.
observation_limits.probes: Only independently owner-authorized original disposable probe keys/versions within exact staging scope. Never delete production objects, use a future task object, or count 403 as capability.
observation_limits.freshness: Original absolute issuer/credential/retention windows and short native physical observation deadlines are separate. Fresh use must satisfy both; do not refresh an old observation by copying/signing it. Historical result access may survive physical observation expiry only after current identity/revocation authorization.
observation_limits.readiness: Schema and classification add zero validator slots and do not establish six-domain readiness, publication, terminal CAS or DR qualification.

classification.all_three: secret / metadata_only / reference_only / pending_owner_review; approved_cross_reviewers stays empty
classification.no_restore: No signed payloads, current states, revisions or role mappings are dumped/restored. Independently enrolled target authority is never overwritten/rolled back.
classification.fresh_census: New full migration catalog/schema identities invalidate prior complete-census and signed-material hashes. Owners must regenerate real source observations/pins; never reuse prior census as complete.

validation.catalog_generation: Source generation only; no build/test/SQL execution
